purpose: Two separate 32-logical C32 diagnostic cohorts, one framework at a time, 80000 input / 600 D output, P1 dispatch per logical request, zero new warmups/flush/retries. Counts, terminals and native cache observations only; not optimization, performance, noise, TTFT or SLA evidence.

stage1_source_fanout.why: Each hybrid-LB API server owns only its eight local EngineCores. One start_profile call on 43 covers DP0-7; one on 45 covers DP8-15. The sets are disjoint, so both calls are necessary and neither double-starts the other's engines. A second start on the same endpoint is forbidden.

citations.fact: One coroutine engine_core.profile_async(True, prefix); the frontend profiler is appended only when self.profiler is not None.
Frontend profiler exists only for profiler=torch and ignore_frontend=false. The installed launch has ignore_frontend=true, so only the engine-core path remains.
DP>1 with external_lb returns DPAsyncMPClient; otherwise DPLBAsyncMPClient; non-DP returns AsyncMPClient. The actual vLLM D argv has DP=16, local=8, start-rank0/8 and neither LB flag.
num_ranks=dp_local_size when local_engines_only else dp_size; core_engines are exactly the managed ranks and core_engine=core_engines[0].
profile_async calls call_utility_async('profile',...); the DPLB override gathers that utility over self.core_engines only, i.e. the eight local engines. There is no coordinator broadcast of profile.
worker_cls='auto' resolves to hardware_profile.default_worker_cls; the installed worker implementation is NPUWorker in vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py line122.

Each TP worker starts/stops TorchNPUProfilerWrapper; the trace name is profile_prefix_rank_suffix, or rank_suffix when the HTTP start_profile supplies no prefix. Every worker step calls profiler.step().

citations.fact: delay_iterations=2 starts on the second step; max_iterations=8 stops when _profiling_for_iters > 8, therefore up to nine recorded worker steps. stop() is idempotent when already inactive.

actual_process_topology.workers: 8 EngineCores x 2 TP workers = 16 worker profilers per D node, 32 across both.

sglang.profile_scope: one native scope API36; FanOutCommunicator to DP0-15 / 32 TP workers; num_steps=2; one start and one bounded stop

vllm.profile_scope: two native scopes API43/DP0-7 and API45/DP8-15, 16 workers each; one start and one bounded stop per scope; no second start on either endpoint

profiler.window_policy: The SGLang two-step and vLLM up-to-nine-step windows are intentionally different. Later analysis must normalize by actual observed per-trace iterations/shape and must not pretend the windows are identical.
